claude.title: Claude Code is installed
claude.why: Agentville watches Claude Code; it doesn't replace it.

login.title: Signed in to Claude Code
login.why: Claude Code needs your Claude account (Pro, Max, Team, Enterprise or Console).
login.how: Open a terminal, run claude, and follow the sign-in steps in your browser.

receiver.title: Agentville's receiver is running
receiver.why: Built into Agentville. Listens only on this computer (127.0.0.1).

hooks.title: Claude Code is connected (hooks installed)
hooks.why: Adds Agentville to your Claude Code settings so sessions report what they're doing. A backup is made first; you can remove it any time.

events.title: A session has appeared
events.why: Each claude session you start becomes a character in the office.
events.how: Start a new claude session in a terminal and send any prompt.

ready.title: All set — monitoring
ready.body: Claude Code is connected to Agentville. Run claude in any project and its character walks into the office.
ready.waiting: Everything is in place. Run claude in any project and send a prompt; the first character will appear.

auto.title: Set everything up automatically
auto.installClaude: Install Claude Code with Anthropic's official installer:
auto.hooks: Connect Claude Code by adding Agentville's hooks to its settings (backup first).
auto.login: Then you sign in to Claude Code once — that part needs you.
auto.consent: Nothing else on your computer is changed.
auto.needsLogin: Almost there: sign in to Claude Code. Click “Sign in”, then follow the steps in your browser.
auto.done: All set. Start claude in any project folder and watch it walk into the office.
